cards.anchor: Correctly commit the seeded initiating component/message/run citation from actually viewed evidence within 12 simulated minutes, with at most one full-suite rerun and preservation of the original initiating record. This is a synthetic exercise; successful commitment remains unobserved.
cards.burden: Instantiate the stipulated logs, two-slot history and action ledger on paper or a spreadsheet; procedurally cover the scoring key. Every forced full rerun costs four minutes and the final full view costs one. Record any commitment cost separately because none is supplied. The two-dose arm deliberately tests an outcome violation and is not an eligible successful procedure.
cards.construction: Hypothesized inspection-first procedure: reset to completed run-1, prohibit new full-suite execution, select retained run-1 in full, and commit a citation before scoring. Validate accuracy, viewed-evidence provenance, rerun count and original-record preservation separately. A negative fixture checks whether the commitment follows the viewed record rather than the known seeded answer.
cards.defeat: Retained-evidence sufficiency fails in an exercised repetition if no correct supported initiating citation can be committed and a documented indispensable context requirement is satisfied only by fresh execution. Unsupported citations, a seeded-answer assertion on the negative fixture, or loss of run-1 invalidate the claimed outcome. Unchanged line content alone cannot establish successful diagnosis or timely commitment.
cards.mutation: Replace the assumed requirement for fresh execution with a retained-evidence inspection step, and attach an original-record preservation veto to any proposed extra execution. Separate execution dose from evidence coverage so an accurate later diagnosis cannot conceal rerun or preservation failures.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: the zero-dose seeded arm supports B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 after one charged view minute; the one-dose arm exposes the same initiating-message information in run-2 after five charged minutes and retains run-1. Two doses reach run-3 after nine charged minutes but evict run-1 and exceed the rerun limit. These are predicted ledgers, not exercised outcomes. On the negative fixture the role should withhold the seeded CONFIG diagnosis; that arm cannot count as seeded-root success.
cards.prediction_rival: Fresh-execution necessity predicts that the zero-dose full view cannot support a valid initiating diagnosis, while the one-dose full view supplies identifiable indispensable additional context. An answer-guessing rival predicts the same seeded CONFIG commitment even when the negative fixture removes its supporting line; such a commitment is invalid.
cards.probe: Run separate reset repetitions with zero, one or two forced consecutive full reruns, independently of next-action requests, followed by one full view of the newest run. Compare the zero- and one-dose seeded arms under identical scoring and diagnosis rules; repeat them with the concealed negative fixture. Commit before uncovering the key. Log requested/executed actions, clock, selected run and lines, initiating visibility, history and citation. Score each outcome dimension separately. This tests execution necessity and provenance; it does not test the unobserved visibility-to-rerun decision link.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable diagnostic context beyond a complete retained log. A separate rival is unsupported reuse of the supplied fixture answer.
unknowns: No exercising-role diagnosis or scored commitment has been observed.
